LanguageData.Gun_KS-23_RWP.label: KS-23
LanguageData.Gun_KS-23_RWP.description: The KS-23 is a formidable heavy shotgun designed for close-quarters combat. Known for its stopping power, it fires large bore shells capable of incapacitating even the toughest adversaries. Though its range is limited, the devastating impact makes it a favorite choice for those who need maximum damage up close. Ideal for breaching and defense situations where power is paramount.
